ISR.headline: Channel 12 exit poll: Likud 24, Yashar 22. Neither bloc reaches 61: the opposition bloc has 52, Netanyahu's bloc 50 and Arab-led parties a record 18.
ISR.headlineIs: Útgönguspá Channel 12: Likud 24, Yashar 22. Hvorug blokkin nær 61: blokk stjórnarandstöðunnar fær 52, blokk Netanyahus 50 og flokkar undir forystu araba metfjölda, 18.
ISR.sourceName: Channel 12 exit poll, 22:00 local time, as reported by Ynet and the Times of Israel
ISR.sourceNameIs: Útgönguspá Channel 12 kl. 22 að staðartíma, samkvæmt Ynet og Times of Israel
ISR.note: Otzma Yehudit's 7 seats follow from Channel 12's bloc total of 50. Channel 13: Likud 25, Yashar 23, Together 14; opposition bloc 53, Netanyahu bloc 50, Arab-led parties 17. Kan: Likud 25, Yashar 21, Together 14; Eisenkot bloc 53, Netanyahu bloc 50, Arab-led parties 17. Below the 3.25% threshold: Reservists, Amcha Yisrael and Haredi Public. Turnout was 74.3% at 20:00 local time (5.45 million votes), the Central Elections Committee says. The official count is under way; more than 650,000 double-envelope ballots are counted separately, possibly until Friday.
ISR.noteIs: 7 sæti Otzma Yehudit leiða af heildartölu Channel 12 fyrir blokk Netanyahus (50). Channel 13: Likud 25, Yashar 23, Beyachad 14; blokk stjórnarandstöðunnar 53, blokk Netanyahus 50, flokkar undir forystu araba 17. Kan: Likud 25, Yashar 21, Beyachad 14; blokk Eisenkot 53, blokk Netanyahus 50, flokkar undir forystu araba 17. Undir 3,25% þröskuldi: HaMiluimnikim, Amcha Yisrael og Haredi Public. Kjörsókn var 74,3% kl. 20 að staðartíma (5,45 milljónir atkvæða) samkvæmt yfirkjörstjórn. Opinber talning stendur yfir; yfir 650.000 utankjörfundaratkvæði í tvöföldu umslagi eru talin sér og talning þeirra gæti staðið fram á föstudag.
